questions: Did these abnormal finger or hand movements begin suddenly, within minutes or hours?
Are the movements present when your hand is completely at rest?
Do they become worse when you use the affected hand?
Are they triggered specifically by writing, typing, playing an instrument, or another particular activity?
Can you temporarily suppress or voluntarily stop the movements?
Does touching another part of your hand or arm temporarily reduce them?
Is the affected hand painful or cramped during the episodes?
Do you experience numbness or altered sensation in that hand?
Do you feel weakness or loss of grip in that hand?
Is only one hand affected?
Do similar involuntary movements affect your other hand, arm, legs, face, jaw, or neck?
Do you have tremor in either hand?
Have you had episodes of loss of awareness, staring, or jerking?
Have you had difficulty speaking, swallowing, walking, or maintaining balance?
Did the symptoms begin after an injury, infection, stroke-like episode, or operation?
Have the symptoms gradually worsened over time?
Are the symptoms substantially different when you are distracted?
Have you started or increased any medication before the symptoms began?
Have you used antipsychotic, anti-nausea, antidepressant, stimulant, or seizure medication?
Does anyone in your family have similar movements, tremor, dystonia, Parkinson disease, or other neurologic illness?
